fact: MCIT and the Ministry of Labour agreed digital literacy and progressive digital-skills training for graduates, job seekers and labour office visitors.

The MCIT and Labor ministries' MoU of 8 October 2026 provides digital-skills programmes for citizens, particularly graduates, job seekers and vulnerable groups, with internationally accredited certificates.

fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology says its "Digital Egypt Generations" initiatives (Cubs, Juniors, Pioneers, Builders) trained about 156,000 people in 2025 and about 277,000 since launch through the end of 2025.
MCIT's Decent Life digital knowledge and competencies programme has improved the digital skills of 164,840 citizens of a 218,155 target (85.80%).

The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology says its Digital Egypt Generations initiatives trained over 220,000 people in 2024, of whom more than 122,000 had graduated, free of charge and open to ages 8 to 88 nationwide.

Minister Raafat Hindy says the ministry runs digital-skills programmes for all ages in all governorates, including Egypt's Digital Generations and Digital Pioneers (with the Egyptian Military Academy), and that over 2 million citizens benefited over the past ten years.

fact: ICT Minister Raafat Hendy said the Digital Egypt Generations initiatives and Digilians train citizens in digital skills and more than two million citizens have benefited from digital capacity-building initiatives over the past decade.
Under an MoU signed on 21 April 2025 the ministry and Microsoft Egypt plan to train about 100,000 trainees on AI, including youth and IT professionals.
